verified: Graph and blast-radius inspection use bounded source captures and never synchronize page metadata or recover operations implicitly
Paged graph reads pin a complete relevant inventory and page projection version
Externally supplied intent uses the same SurfaceDiscovery and RegionScoper without provider orchestration
Title, URL, filesystem subtree move, deletion, nav visibility and order become retained exact change sets with shared navigation/reference/include transformations
Structural page and collection preconditions are sealed, rechecked and committed atomically with revision, version and operation result
Stable page IDs survive URL changes and subtree moves; collection page references survive moves and delete undo/redo
Homepage protection, collisions, unsupported references, shallow navigation, hidden deep pages and query/fragment-preserving link rewrites
Visual edits validate unique exact source address, span hash and whole-file hash, then use the shared PatchExecutor pure preparation helper; stale or ambiguous selection never guesses
Only dedicated SEO intent can alter _root/robots.txt and _root/llms.txt; publish preserves or generates complete reviewed root files and describes the policy
Whole-operation byte and projection rollback, metadata drift preserved as recovery_required, explicit repaired recovery, current structural scopes at apply/commit
Private asset planner seam preserves exact server-read binary bytes without structure permissions, SEO elevation or image re-encoding
All five legacy structural suites now seed independent canonical temporary roots with full migrations and guarded constructors; no installed DB or generated checkout copies
